title: Out of the limelight
visual_consistency: A continuous classic film-star picnic comedy with the same group of famous actors and actresses throughout: Gloria Gleam, elegant but disguised; Brinksley Meers, confident but dressed down; Rockwall Slinger and Merlin Greeves, awkward when challenged; all wearing dark glasses, old plain clothes, simple hats, and deliberately ordinary styling. The setting is a dry river bed with scattered trees, a shady picnic spot, large food baskets, and an old worn bus nearby. A stern local sheriff appears later as a blunt authority figure, not violent. The camping rule is shown only through a blank notice board or simple non-readable pictogram. Images must contain no readable signs, actor names, bus markings, newspaper text, film posters, fan signs, sheriff badge text, vehicle plates, captions, speech bubbles, UI panels, letters, words, or numbers.
